passages.text: But as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.
passages.sermon:
You must speak.
You must say what is right.
You must teach what matches sound doctrine.
Sound doctrine is healthy teaching.
Your words must agree with true Christian teaching.
passages.original: Σὺ δὲ λάλει ἃ πρέπει τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ διδασκαλίᾳ

passages.text: Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, love, and perseverance.
passages.sermon:
Older men must show certain qualities.
They must be temperate.
They must be dignified.
They must be self-controlled.
They must be sound in faith.
They must be sound in love.
They must be sound in perseverance.
passages.original: Πρεσβύτας νηφαλίους εἶναι σεμνούς σώφρονας ὑγιαίνοντας τῇ πίστει τῇ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ὑπομονῇ

passages.text: Older women, likewise, are to be reverent in their behavior, not slanderers or addicted to much wine, but teachers of good.
passages.sermon:
Older women must act with reverence.
They must not slander others.
They must not be addicted to much wine.
They must teach what is good.
passages.original: πρεσβύτιδας ὡσαύτως ἐν καταστήματι ἱεροπρεπεῖς μὴ διαβόλους μηδὲ οἴνῳ πολλῷ δεδουλωμένας καλοδιδασκάλους

passages.text: In this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children, to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.
passages.sermon:
Older women must teach young women.
Young women must love their husbands.
Young women must love their children.
Young women must be self-controlled.
Young women must be pure.
Young women must manage their households.
Young women must be kind.
Young women must submit to their own husbands.
In this way, no one will discredit the word of God.
passages.original: ἵνα σωφρονίζωσιν τὰς νέας φιλάνδρους εἶναι φιλοτέκνους σώφρονας ἁγνάς οἰκουργούς ἀγαθάς ὑποτασσομένας τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν ἵνα μὴ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ βλασφημῆται

passages.text: In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
passages.sermon:
Paul speaks to Titus.
\r\nPaul gives instructions for the church.
\r\nPaul addresses younger men.
\r\nUrge the younger men.
\r\nTell them to be self-controlled.
\r\nGive them this instruction just as you give to others.

passages.text: In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity, and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed to have nothing bad to say about us.
passages.sermon:
Show yourself as an example in everything you do.
Do good works.
Teach with integrity.
Teach with dignity.
Speak in a healthy and blameless way.
Let your words be above reproach.
Then anyone who opposes us will feel ashamed.
They will have nothing bad to say about us.
passages.original: Περὶ πάντα σεαυτὸν παρεχόμενος τύπον καλῶν ἔργων ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ ἀφθορίαν σεμνότητα λόγον ὑγιῆ ἀκατάγνωστον ἵνα ὁ ἐξ ἐναντίας ἐντραπῇ μηδὲν ἔχων λέγειν περὶ ἡμῶν φαῦλον

passages.text: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative, not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior.
passages.sermon:
Slaves must obey their own masters in everything.
Slaves must try to please their masters in all things.
Slaves must not argue with their masters.
Slaves must not steal from their masters.
Slaves must always show good faith.
Slaves must act this way so that they make the teaching about God our Savior beautiful in every way.
passages.original: Δούλους ἰδίοις δεσπόταις ὑποτάσσεσθαι ἐν πᾶσιν εὐαρέστους εἶναι μὴ ἀντιλέγοντας μὴ νοσφιζομένους ἀλλὰ πᾶσαν πίστιν ἐνδεικνυμένους ἀγαθήν ἵνα τὴν διδασκαλίαν τὴν τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Θεοῦ κοσμῶσιν ἐν πᾶσιν

passages.text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
passages.sermon:
God is gracious.
God’s grace has appeared.
God’s grace brings salvation.
God’s grace brings salvation to everyone.
passages.original: Ἐπεφάνη γὰρ ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ σωτήριος πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις

passages.text: It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age, as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
passages.sermon:
God gives us grace.
God’s grace teaches us.
God’s grace instructs us to reject ungodliness.
God’s grace instructs us to reject worldly passions.
God’s grace teaches us to live with self-control.
God’s grace teaches us to live upright lives.
God’s grace teaches us to live godly lives.
We live this way now, in the present age.
We wait for the blessed hope.
We wait for the glorious appearance of Jesus Christ.
Jesus Christ is our great God and Savior.
passages.original: παιδεύουσα ἡμᾶς ἵνα ἀρνησάμενοι τὴν ἀσέβειαν καὶ τὰς κοσμικὰς ἐπιθυμίας σωφρόνως καὶ δικαίως καὶ εὐσεβῶς ζήσωμεν ἐν τῷ νῦν αἰῶνι προσδεχόμενοι τὴν μακαρίαν ἐλπίδα καὶ ἐπιφάνειαν τῆς δόξης τοῦ μεγάλου Θεοῦ καὶ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ

passages.text: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
passages.sermon:
Jesus Christ is our great God and Savior.
Jesus Christ gave Himself for us.
He did this to redeem us from all lawlessness.
He did this to purify a people for Himself.
These people belong to Him.
These people are eager to do good deeds.
passages.original: ὃς ἔδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἵνα λυτρώσηται ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἀνομίας καὶ καθαρίσῃ ἑαυτῷ λαὸν περιούσιον ζηλωτὴν καλῶν ἔργων

passages.text: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
passages.sermon:
You must speak these things.
You must encourage others.
You must rebuke with all authority.
Do not let anyone despise you.
passages.original: Ταῦτα λάλει καὶ παρακάλει καὶ ἔλεγχε μετὰ πάσης ἐπιταγῆς μηδείς σου περιφρονείτω
